utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, it’s still happening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Same time and place as planned?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m with you—what details do you want me to check about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check where the repair drive is being held, what time it starts, and whether they need any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check those details and get back to you: the location, start time, and any tools or supplies they want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Dane—I’m getting the repair drive organized and keeping the moving pieces tidy. Let me know what you need covered first, and I’ll line it up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with whatever’s most urgent—what should I grab first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great timing, Dane—could you start by checking in with the arrivals and helping set up the tool table? I’ll keep the list updated and send you straight to the next urgent task.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces, Gus—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by with my toolbox later and help where it’s needed. I haven’t heard every detail yet, but I’m happy to lend a hand on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really kind of you, Gus—thank you. I’ll pass that along and see where your toolbox can be most useful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. The front steps are the most urgent—they’ve been loose for a while.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the front steps. If you can point out the worst spots, I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’d say we should line up the tools, check who can help, and get the repair drive started this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help line up the tools and check with a few folks right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Sam — I’ll start the repair drive prep and we can compare notes this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll pass the word along right away—if you’re up for it, I can help get a few more neighbors to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be much appreciated, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple: just let them know the time, place, and that I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll keep it simple and spread the word with the time, place, and that you’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re hoping to get a few more volunteers before the weekend—if you’re free, it’d really help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I can probably help out. Remind me what they need done, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly simple stuff—sorting donated tools, carrying supplies, and helping folks with the small fixes. If you can come even for a couple hours, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye — I’d like to avoid the school rush if we can. Maybe something after 3:30, when pickup traffic eases?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — after 3:30 is much easier. I’ll help line things up around pickup so we can keep the traffic stress low.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. If you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, and I’ll pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, the repair drive? I’m a bit scattered, but I can help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — we just need a few folks to bring tools, spare parts, and maybe a little time this weekend. I can remind you of the details one by one if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help a lot — start with the tools, and I’ll try to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Cleo, what do you need most for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly screws, duct tape, and a few work gloves. If you’ve got extra batteries too, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll look for screws, duct tape, work gloves, and extra batteries. Do you want any specific sizes or brands?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing, where the drop-off is, and whether we need to sort the items before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I heard it’s this Saturday morning at the community hall, and they said no need to sort anything—just bring what you’ve got. I can double-check the drop-off spot if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thanks. If you can confirm the exact drop-off spot and what time Saturday morning, I can let you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on for today, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still on for today — I’ve got my tools ready. Swing by anytime and we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure. I’ll swing by later today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple: we make a short list, set a time, and then stick to it. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll help sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The front gate is the first thing I’d fix, then the loose step by the porch. After that, we can set a time and keep the rest on a short list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right to me. Let’s start with the front gate, then the porch step, and keep everything else on one short list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s lovely, Vik — thank you! I’ll keep an ear out and let everyone know the latest as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks and make sure everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can also invite a few extra neighbors who are usually happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Quinn—thank you. The more neighbors we can gather, the smoother the repair drive will go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll reach out to a few more folks today and let them know we’d love their help. I’ll keep you posted as responses come in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane — we’re still on track. I’m just checking a couple last volunteers and the tool list, then I’ll send the final update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — want me to help round up those last volunteers or double-check the tool list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things quiet on my end right now. If you tell me what’s most urgent, I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — the most urgent thing is getting the repair list sorted so we know what to tackle first. If you can help quietly with that, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. Send me the list, and I’ll sort it quietly and flag the most urgent pieces first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — we could use some screwdrivers, a drill if you’ve got one, and maybe a box of spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got a screwdriver set and spare screws. I’ll check for the drill and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—can you track nails, screws, paint, and a few tarps? I’ll check what’s already been donated and send you the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll keep a running list of nails, screws, paint, and tarps, and update it as donations come in. Just send me what’s already covered, and I’ll note the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam — I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — the biggest help right now is getting a few more volunteers and a place to keep the tools overnight. If you can connect people, I can handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can reach out to a couple of friend groups for volunteers and ask around for a secure spot to store the tools overnight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I keep mixing up the details, so I’m grateful you’re checking around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem — I’ll ask around and bring back the clearest version I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: You missed the details for the repair drive. I’m checking the plan first so I can tell you exactly what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—thanks for checking. I’m here and ready when you’ve got the plan.
